versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Create Volunteer Orientation Voice Script skill.

- Enables creation of onboarding scripts for volunteers, suitable for audio or live delivery.
- Designed for use in nonprofit and development team settings.
- Includes workflow steps for clarifying audience, drafting, refining, and finalizing scripts.
- Optimized for volunteer onboarding and community program introduction use cases.
- Integrates chat and text-to-speech (TTS) API support.
